newsitem.title: GERMANY: GRUNDIG[GRNG.CN] SEES SHARPLY LOWER LOSS IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: GRUNDIG[GRNG.CN] SEES SHARPLY LOWER LOSS IN 1997.

text.p: Germany's struggling consumer electronics maker Grundig AG said on Thursday it expected to cut operating losses to less than 100 million marks ($59.3 million) this year.
The company earlier reported an operating loss of 382 million marks for 1996, the last year for which its largest shareholder Philips NV must step in to offset losses.
